scope: Cumulative Graphics Advance 6 built on the exact approved Advance 5 ROM. It changes only the Backpack quantity-renderer far call and hosts a compact 3x5 digit wrapper in the verified unreferenced tail of the existing B1 data allocation. Each visible quantity is reassigned to one exclusive runtime tile pair selected only after a complete ROM-map and live cross-layer consumer audit; the shared large numeric font, digits inside chip names, capacities, MB labels, icons, card statistics, maps, palettes, dialogue and all other A5 content remain unchanged.
